title: Biupui DigiCiv Architecture and Farming Simulator Integration Map
scope: Digital-civilisation simulation, observed-map generation, architecture/farming system modelling, and light-based information-transfer research.

governance.digiCat: Catalogue capabilities, entities, relationships, simulator interfaces, observed maps and benchmark dimensions.
governance.digiFile: Record source identity, simulator inputs/outputs, hashes, observations, experiments, provenance and promotion state.
governance.learning: Learn from simulated and observed behaviour; propose changes only after regression/evidence gates.
governance.quanticor: Controlled referee for native, federated and quantum-model intersections. No uncontrolled production collision.
governance.computational_geometry: Canonical machine-readable relationship/behaviour representation; does not replace executable truth.
governance.executable_truth: Source, simulator execution, build/test/runtime evidence remain acceptance authority.

digiciv.definition: A machine-readable digital-civilisation matrix representing interacting built, ecological, agricultural, technological, information and energy systems.

simulator_integrations.role: Agricultural/ecological system simulation and telemetry model.

light_information_transfer.purpose: Map light-based information paths through simulated architecture and agricultural environments.
light_information_transfer.observed_map_rule: Observed optical/environmental measurements must be stored separately from simulated predictions.
light_information_transfer.simulation_rule: Simulation may generate candidate paths and expected behaviour but cannot be promoted as measured physical performance.

native_quantum_protocol.quantum_boundary: Quantum states, routing and photonic-quantum behaviour remain computational/research models unless physical hardware evidence exists.
native_quantum_protocol.native_priority: Use native computational geometry, simulator and executable paths first; federation/adapters are introduced only when capability evidence requires them.

required_evidence: physical measurement for any physical performance claim
